meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为应用加上安全的登录、授权与访问控制
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要用户登录和权限分配的系统
copy.tagline_en: Add secure login, authorization, and access control to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs user login and permissions

howto.what: 你会得到一套认证授权方案的代码示例,包括 JWT 登录与刷新令牌、Session 会话、OAuth2 社交登录、角色与权限控制等,可直接套用到项目中。
howto.when: 当你想做用户登录、给接口加权限校验,或者排查认证授权相关问题(如 JWT 报错、OAuth 回调失败)时,它会按标准模式给出方案。

say.text: 用 JWT 实现带刷新令牌的登录接口
给我的 Express API 加上基于角色的权限控制
say.note: 会生成 RBAC 中间件,只有指定角色能访问对应路由。

say.text: 帮我调试 OAuth2 回调时 invalid_grant 报错
say.note: 会按令牌校验、存储等环节定位原因。

howto.what_en: You'll get code examples for authentication/authorization patterns including JWT login & refresh tokens, session management, OAuth2 social login, RBAC and permission checks, ready to apply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to implement user login, add permission checks to APIs, debug auth issues (e.g., JWT errors, OAuth failures), or design session management/RBAC.

say_en.text: Implement a JWT login endpoint with refresh tokens.
say_en.note: Generates access/refresh token issuing, verification, and refresh logic.

say_en.text: Add role-based access control to my Express API.
say_en.note: Creates RBAC middleware restricting routes by role.

say_en.text: Help debug invalid_grant error in OAuth2 callback.
say_en.note: Walks through token validation and storage to find the cause.
